title: JopeDime binary classification fitness v1
description: Strict binary objectives on calibrated probabilities (spec §5.10). logloss, brier and cost_matrix_loss minimize; roc_auc, pr_auc, f1 and balanced_accuracy maximize. Runtime bounds spec JSON to 32 KiB, refuses duplicate keys, and enforces input alignment, class membership/order and probability sums. Calibration and event integration are separate. Multiclass is deferred.

metric.description: logloss: -ln(p_true), without clipping; brier: (p_positive - is_positive)^2 without a factor of two; both retain mean/sum row aggregation and are defined on single-class folds. roc_auc uses tie-averaged ROC area; pr_auc is average precision. f1 uses the positive class and threshold, defaulting to 0.5, with p_positive >= threshold predicting positive. balanced_accuracy uses threshold 0.5. cost_matrix_loss uses threshold 0.5 and the supplied matrix with rows=actual and columns=predicted. New dataset-level metrics require both classes in each fold and mean aggregation; runtime refuses these single-class folds with FITNESS_UNDEFINED.

aggregation.description: For logloss and brier: unweighted arithmetic mean or sum of row losses over all supplied held-out rows. Dataset-level metrics require mean aggregation and produce one score per fold; threshold metrics are averaged by mean across folds.

undefined.description: Invalid inputs, undefined/non-finite losses or predictions return FITNESS_UNDEFINED for this candidate only. Never return a placeholder score or fail the whole run.

threshold.description: Optional F1-only threshold. Omitted means 0.5; p_positive >= threshold predicts the positive class. F1 objective identity canonicalizes an omitted threshold to 0.5. Other metrics refuse this parameter.

cost_matrix.description: Required only for cost_matrix_loss. Rows are actual class [negative, positive], columns are predicted class [negative, positive]: [[C_TN,C_FP],[C_FN,C_TP]]. Entries must be finite and non-negative; runtime rejects non-finite values. Other metrics refuse this parameter.

class_order.description: Two distinct exact class names in probability-column order; class_order[1] is positive.

inputs.description: Runtime additionally requires equal nonzero row counts, exact agreement with the specification's class_order, labels drawn from those classes, finite probabilities and each pair summing to one within absolute tolerance 1e-12. No renormalization or clipping.
